strings.errorconfigdisplaysize: The form input size must be between 1 and 200 characters.
strings.errorconfiglinkplaceholder: The link must contain a placeholder $$.
strings.errorconfiglinksyntax: The link must be a valid URL starting with either http:// or https://.
strings.errorconfigmaxlen: The maximum number of characters allowed must be between 1 and 1333.
strings.errormaxlength: The maximum number of characters allowed in this field is {$a}.
strings.islink_help: To transform the text into a link, enter a URL containing $$ as a placeholder, where $$ will be replaced with the text. For example, to transform a Twitter ID to a link, enter https://twitter.com/$$.
strings.privacy:metadata: The Short text field type plugin doesn't store any personal data; it uses tables defined in core.
